TlsRouteRouteDestination.description: Describe the destination for traffic to be routed to.

serviceName.description: Required. The URL of a BackendService to route traffic to.

weight.description: Optional. Specifies the proportion of requests forwarded to the backend referenced by the service_name field. This is computed as: - weight/Sum(weights in destinations) Weights in all destinations does not need to sum up to 100.

enumDescriptions: Default value. Should not be used.

resourceTypes.description: Required. The types of resources to which the binding should attach. Limited to 1 resource type.

parent.description: Required. The parent resource that defines the scope, in the format `projects/{project_number}`. When the scope is a project, the binding applies to the resources that meet all of the following conditions: * The resource belongs to the specified project. * The resource is in the same location as the `ExtensionBinding`. * The resource type is listed in `resource_types`.

ExtensionBindingTargetScope.description: Specifies the scope of resources to which this binding should attach.

deleteTime.description: Output only. The time when this resource was soft-deleted. Only populated if the resource is in the process of being deleted.

loggingConfiguration.description: Optional. Specifies the top-level configuration block within the telemetry policy that contains all the settings for how logging will be applied to the target resources.

etag.description: Provides a mechanism for optimistic concurrency control. If this is provided, it must match the server's etag. If the provided etag does not match the server's etag, the request will fail with a 409 ABORTED error.

metricsConfiguration.description: Optional. Specifies the top-level configuration block within the telemetry policy that contains all the settings for how metrics will be applied to the target resources.

displayName.description: Optional. Provides a human-readable name for the policy.

uid.description: Output only. Specifies the server-assigned unique identifier for the policy.

createTime.description: Output only. Indicates the timestamp when the resource was created.

updateTime.description: Output only. Indicates the timestamp when the resource was last updated.

reconciling.description: Output only. If true, the service is currently reconciling the resource to the desired state.

telemetryTarget.description: Required. Specifies the set of targets to which this telemetry policy applies.

tracingConfiguration.description: Optional. Specifies the top-level configuration block within the telemetry policy that contains all the settings for how tracing will be applied to the target resources.

labels.description: Optional. Set of label tags associated with the TelemetryPolicy resource.

name.description: Identifier. Represents the resource name of the policy. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/telemetryPolicies/{telemetry_policy}`

MetadataLabels.description: Defines a name-pair value for a single label.

labelName.description: Required. Label name presented as key in xDS Node Metadata.

labelValue.description: Required. Label value presented as value corresponding to the above key, in xDS Node Metadata.

OperationMetadata.description: Represents the metadata of the long-running operation.

endTime.description: Output only. The time the operation finished running.

createTime.description: Output only. The time the operation was created.

statusMessage.description: Output only. Human-readable status of the operation, if any.

verb.description: Output only. Name of the verb executed by the operation.

target.description: Output only. Server-defined resource path for the target of the operation.

apiVersion.description: Output only. API version used to start the operation.

requestedCancellation.description: Output only. Identifies whether the user has requested cancellation of the operation. Operations that have successfully been cancelled have Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of 1, corresponding to `Code.CANCELLED`.
